facts.fact: Human Rights Watch says the youth movement GenZ212 called nationwide protests from 27 September 2025 criticising public spending on mega-sporting events and demanding more for health care and education.

Human Rights Watch reports the Agadir Court of First Instance sentenced a man on 4 October 2025 to four years in prison and a 50,000 dirham fine for 'inciting minor offenses and crimes via social media'.
